packs.name: Music: records, gigs and friends
packs.description: A small record collection with the artists, gigs, venues and friends around it, including who signed what and where.

packs.name: Recipes
packs.description: A few family and cookbook recipes with ingredient tables, full methods, and where each one came from.

packs.name: Movies
packs.description: Films you have watched, where and with whom, plus the posters you have collected and who signed them.

packs.name: Electronic parts
packs.description: A small parts drawer: what is in stock, what is running low, what each build uses and who sells it.

packs.name: Board games
packs.description: A shelf of board games with their publishers and designers, the game nights they came out at, and a wishlist of the ones still to get.
